title: Why Buffett Disciple Guy Spier's Decision to Close Fund Is Bullish: Noble - Business Insider
summary: Guy Spier's decision to close his Aquamarine Fund signals a shift in perspective on active stock-picking, as he believes the advantages for stock-pickers no longer exist. Conversely, George Noble sees this as a bullish signal for active management, citing historical resilience and the potential for unexplored opportunities.
sentiment_reason: George Noble views the closure of the fund as a positive sign for active management, suggesting that it's a golden age for stock picking with untapped potential in various sectors.
